The '''Gammalin Colony''' was the only settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gammalin]]. Its entire population was [[Human/Legends|Human]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the entire [[City/Legends|city]] was [[Death/Legends|wiped out]] by the [[Emperor's Plague]].
